speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
text: asked	the Acting Minister for Education (Schools) in view of the forthcoming merger of Bedok North Secondary School with Damai Secondary School in January 2018, whether the Ministry will consider locating the merged school at the premises of Bedok North Secondary School in view of better transportation links at the location of this school.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
text: On the other hand, the Bedok North Secondary School site is located at the edge of the Kaki Bukit industrial estate.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
text: In addition, the Damai Secondary School site is served by more bus services compared to the Bedok North Secondary site.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
text: MOE will work with both schools to ensure a smooth merger and provide the best learning outcomes for its students and at the same time, forge a strong school identity for the school community.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
text: I understand that it is still classified as an area reserved for educational facilities.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
text: Thirdly, how important a factor is the convenience of students and teachers, when MOE decides on the location of merged schools?

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: If I can take the first and the last ones together?

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: I do appreciate the difference in the walking time from the two schools to the MRT station, but it is still fairly comfortable.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: There are a number of considerations and distance to the MRT station is not the only one.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: Convenience is a factor and there are a number of components other than convenience.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: With respect to the URA masterplan, MOE will have a look at site and make an assessment about the need within MOE for the site in terms of MOE initiatives and plans going forward.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: If MOE has no particular use for the site, the site will be returned to the Singapore Land Authority (SLA) who will then make an assessment of what happens downstream.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
text: And I thank the Minister of State for answering the questions.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
text: In view of the fact that upgrading is going to be carried out at Damai Secondary School, to be completed by the end of 2018, is there any prospect of a change of decision to move it back to Bedok North Secondary and what is the likelihood of that eventuality, since the Minister of State does recognise that there are advantages to have the merged school at the present location of Bedok North Secondary School?

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: I am not sure I said that there was an advantage to the merged school being at Bedok North Secondary.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: I do not quite understand – is the Member suggesting that the upgrading should not happen at Damai Secondary?

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
text: I am suggesting that if the upgrading has not started, is there a prospect of locating the merged school at the Bedok North Secondary site because there is also a football field there?

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
text: If I remember correctly, I believe it is an artificial turf, it is already turfed, and there is an indoor badminton hall.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
text: So, a number of facilities are already available for the community also to use.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
text: There could be savings accrued, rather than upgrading a school when the advantages are already pre-located at Bedok North Secondary School.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: There are a number of factors that are taken into account in terms of where to locate a merged school and how the pairs should be chosen, and of the pairs, where the final location should be.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: Transport and convenience, we have talked about; the ability of the facilities to be upgraded, disruption to the school, and so forth.
